'''Cryptology Research Society of India (CRSI)''' is a scientific organisation that supports research in [[India]] on [[cryptography]], [[data security]], and related fields.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=12 May 2007|title=Cryptology Research Society of India|url=http://www.crsind.com/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070809143150/http://www.crsind.com/|archive-date=9 August 2007|access-date=20 June 2021|website=www.crsind.com}}</ref> The organisation was founded in 2001.<ref name=":1" /> CRSI organises workshops and conferences about cryptology.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|date=2017-06-28|title=In an unsafe cyber world, here's why you should study cryptology|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/education/in-an-unsafe-cyber-world-here-s-why-you-should-study-cryptology/story-ugWx43ZVSzXVMn4nKbxgnI.html|access-date=2022-01-29|website=Hindustan Times|language=en}}</ref> 

== Activities ==
{{Expand section|date=January 2022}}[[Image:Asiacrypt06.jpg|thumb|250px|Asiacrypt 2005 organised by CRSI associating with IITM in Taj hotel, Chennai.|left]]

CRSI organises several annual workshops and conferences about cryptology.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|date=2017-06-28|title=In an unsafe cyber world, here's why you should study cryptology|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/education/in-an-unsafe-cyber-world-here-s-why-you-should-study-cryptology/story-ugWx43ZVSzXVMn4nKbxgnI.html|access-date=2022-01-29|website=Hindustan Times|language=en}}</ref> More specifically, CRSI organises the annual events [[INDOCRYPT]], an international conference on cryptography,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Cryptology Research Society of India|url=https://crsind.in/index.php/events/indocrypt-conference/|access-date=2022-01-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title= Cryptography is wealth generator: Kalam|date= 2004-12-21|url= http://www.hindu.com/2004/12/21/stories/2004122108260400.htm|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20050124203641/http://www.hindu.com/2004/12/21/stories/2004122108260400.htm|url-status= dead|work= [[The Hindu]]|archive-date= 2005-01-24}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-12-13|title=International Conference on Cryptology-Indocrypt 2018, conducted at India Habitat Centre|url=https://www.thestatesman.com/books-education/international-conference-on-cryptology-indocrypt-2018-conducted-at-india-habitat-centre-1502716103.html|access-date=2022-01-29|website=The Statesman|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=India|first=The Hans|date=2019-12-17|title=Conference on cryptology held at HICC Convention|url=https://www.thehansindia.com/news/cities/hyderabad/conference-on-cryptology-held-at-hicc-convention-590402|access-date=2022-01-29|website=www.thehansindia.com|language=en}}</ref> 
and the Indian national workshop on cryptology.<ref name=":0">{{cite news|title=National workshop on Cryptology begins|date= 2004-09-11|url= http://www.hindu.com/2004/09/11/stories/2004091106330300.htm|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20041114170947/http://www.hindu.com/2004/09/11/stories/2004091106330300.htm|url-status= dead|work=[[The Hindu]]|archive-date= 2004-11-14}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=Presidency University Bengaluru Inaugurated National Workshop On Cryptology 2019|url=http://bweducation.businessworld.in/article/Presidency-University-Bengaluru-Inaugurated-National-Workshop-On-Cryptology-2019/26-09-2019-176747|access-date=2022-01-29|website=BW Education|language=en}}</ref> It also arranged the [[International Association for Cryptologic Research]]'s (IACR) workshop on [[Fast Software Encryption]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Call|url=https://www.iacr.org/workshops/fse2004/callforapp.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060925005050/https://www.iacr.org/workshops/fse2004/callforapp.html|archive-date=25 September 2006|access-date=29 January 2022|website=www.iacr.org}}</ref> in 2003 at [[New Delhi]] {{Citation needed|date=January 2022}}and IACR's conference [[Asiacrypt]] in 2013<ref>{{Cite web|title=Preface to IACR ASIACRYPT: Advances in Cryptology (ASIACRYPT) 2013|url=https://www.iacr.org/archive/asiacrypt2013/preface.html|access-date=29 January 2022|website=www.iacr.org}}</ref> and in 2005 at [[Chennai]].{{Citation needed|date=June 2021}}

In 2024, CRSI hosted ASIACRYPT 2024 in Kolkata from December 9 to 13, followed by the ASK 2024 workshop at TCG CREST, Kolkata, from December 14 to 17.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Asiacrypt 2024 |url=https://asiacrypt.iacr.org/2024/ |access-date=2024-11-03 |website=asiacrypt.iacr.org |language=en}}</ref>

In 2025, CRSI held the International Conference on Cryptology in India (INDOCRYPT 2025) at the [[International Institute of Information Technology, Bhubaneswar]] on December 15.<ref>{{Cite web|title=INDOCRYPT 2025 Kicks Off at IIIT-Bhubaneswar: A Hub for Cryptography Minds|url=https://pragativadi.com/indocrypt-2025-kicks-off-at-iiit-bhubaneswar-a-hub-for-cryptography-minds/|website=Pragativadi I Latest Odisha News in English I Breaking News|date=2025-12-15|access-date=2026-02-02|language=en-US|first=Yajati|last=Rout}}</ref>

== Organizational structure ==
The main office of CRSI is located in [[Kolkata]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Cryptology Research Society of India|url=https://crsind.in/index.php/about-crsi/activities-of-crsi/|access-date=2022-01-29}}</ref> CRSI was founded by the current general secretary Prof. Bimal Roy, former Director of the [[Indian Statistical Institute]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2015-03-23|title=Bimal Kumar Roy|url=https://uwaterloo.ca/combinatorics-and-optimization/graduate-studies-combinatorics-and-optimization-c-and-o/alumni-profiles/bimal-kumar-roy|access-date=2022-01-29|website=Combinatorics and Optimization|language=en}}</ref>{{Verify source|date=January 2022}} Padmashree R. Balasubramaniam, {{Citation needed span|text=Director of IMSc|date=January 2022}}, is the organization's president.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Cryptology Research Society of India|url=https://crsind.in/index.php/about-crsi/executive-committee/|access-date=2022-01-29}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|title=Presidency University Bengaluru Inaugurated National Workshop On Cryptology 2019|url=http://bweducation.businessworld.in/article/Presidency-University-Bengaluru-Inaugurated-National-Workshop-On-Cryptology-2019/26-09-2019-176747|access-date=2022-01-29|website=BW Education|language=en}}</ref>
